title: English Practice Quiz 0873
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.
